scientific_integrity: The global support-selection proof relies on exact triangular ratios and a logistic lower bound, not on finite-horizon numerics. Originality comparisons cover the primary source, an older three-species carrying-simplex article, and older global-attractor criteria; stronger unindexed competition-system statements remain possible. No independent scientific assessment has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to deterministic finite directed chains with identical positive reproduction and mortality rates, positive directed predation, r>d, and nonzero nonnegative initial occupancy. No heterogeneous-rate, finite-population stochastic, immigration or zero-predation extension is asserted. The final convergence rate depends on the initial state.
title: Exact greedy survival and terminal abundance in a symmetric hierarchical ecological chain
